house_style: Warm storybook illustration for a second grade classroom tool: soft gouache texture, clean dark outline, gentle shading, a real-looking pet with natural proportions (not chibi, not a cartoon mascot), friendly calm face with natural eyes and a small nose. No text, no letters, no collar tags, no props, no ground, no shadow.
